The '''Flame-God''' was the name used by the [[M'ust]] race to describe the deity embodied by the subterranean flames which filled their underground lairs. [[Cody Sunn-Childe]] claimed to have been reformed after coming in contact with the Flame-God, rebutting violence in order to embrace peace and imbue himself with the ability to give life to his own dreams.<ref name="marvel46" />
